# Audit findings

`pnpm typecheck` is clean and **returns zero errors** — but four real defects sit behind that green signal.

## Blockers

Unacked user data is auto-deleted without confirmation. `sweepRetentionAuto` gates `storageSurfaceAcked` inside the per-workspace loop — see [[src/main/agent/loop.ts:12]].

### Major

- First bullet with `code` and a [[src/renderer/src/lib/ui/MarkdownContent.tsx:404]] citation.
- Second bullet.
  1. Nested ordered item.
  2. Another nested item.

> The size cap counts six categories it can never reclaim.

#### Minor

1. Ordered item one.
2. Ordered item two.

| File | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| src/main/storage/retention.ts | blocking | evicts checkpoints only |
| src/main/headless/runTask.ts | blocking | overwrites a real error |

```ts
const reclaimed = reclaimableBytes >= excessBytes
```

- [x] typecheck clean
- [ ] renderer suite green
